question: I activate Hydra Broodmaster's monstrosity ability with X equal to 3. Do the X values in its 'becomes monstrous' trigger use the 3 I chose when I activated the ability?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: each X equals the value chosen for X when the monstrosity ability was activated.
expected.answer: The value of each X in Hydra Broodmaster's last ability is equal to the value chosen for X when its monstrosity ability was activated.
